Not an end-to-end semantic accuracy claim.

graph-level element-wise comparison of the DB sigmoid map against the Paddle Inference predictor of the GGUF source archive on a real official page (export_ocr_fixture.py det, imgs/00006737.jpg). The strict CUDA 2x2/stride-2 conv_transpose path and OCR-scoped Vulkan exact-F32 matmul reduce the F32 CPU/CUDA/Vulkan max_diff to about 2e-5; F16/Q8_0 retain weight-quantization noise at transition pixels and are gated separately. Complete pipeline box/text agreement is separately diagnostic (run_ocr_official_alignment.py).

semantic GT: PubTabNet TEDS/TEDS-S of the full det/rec + SLANet_plus chain (one uniform quantization, as qOCR runs it) on the 100-table PaddleX table_rec_dataset_examples val split, against the official PaddleX 3.0.1 table_recognition pipeline with the same upstream models on the same images (run_paddle_table_baseline.py on the digest-verified source det/rec weights of the GGUFs, ocr.source.sha256 via paddle_source_models.py - the PaddleX default PP-OCRv4_mobile_det is a different checkpoint: TEDS 0.9646149 / TEDS-S 0.9959180); tolerance 0.005 / 0.002.

semantic GT of the composed layout -> table -> det/rec chain: each GT table pasted into a deterministic document page (make_table_layout_pages.py, pages.txt pinned), the table found by layout over the pasted box scored by TEDS; gated against the official composed chain (PP-Structure CDLA layout fed to PaddleX table_recognition as layout_det_res, det/rec on the digest-verified GGUF source weights: TEDS 0.5463327, TEDS-S 0.5926333, table recall 0.64 - the upstream CDLA model labels synthetic left/right-border tables 'figure'). Composed-page TEDS is a placement lottery: a sub-pixel layout-region delta crosses the int-truncation crop boundary and flips the SLANet structure decode (measured: 0.3 px -> 13x3 -> 13x4 columns, -0.22 TEDS on one pinned page), so the measured nominal-draw band on the pinned 100 pages is 0.5409-0.5453 across f32/f16/q8_0 artifacts; the composed TEDS tolerance is 0.006 (Paddle-0.006 = 0.5403327) to cover that band, and run_table_gt_matrix.py --jitter-ensemble provides a placement-robust diagnostic (f32 0.5344 vs q8_0 0.5329 under +-1 px draws: the quantization gap shrinks to ~0.0015).
